row_zero_to_6(R) :- row_has_3(R), row_has_4(R), not row_zero_to_4(R).

% Zero‑cell handling – three mutually exclusive cases

output(R, C, 6) :- output_cell(R, C), input(R, C, 0), row_zero_to_6(R).

col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

output_cell(R, C) :- row(R), col(C).

1 { output(R, C, Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R, C).

% 3. Helper: does a row contain a 2 ?
row_has_two(R) :- input(R, C, 2).
